subject: Cyclone Labs: security review & onboarding session - scheduling
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jansen <alex.jansen@cyclonelabs.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Cyclone security review - proposed windows and attendees

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, we'd like to schedule a dedicated security review so Cyclone's security and SSO teams can meet Redwood Security and our SE. Proposed attendees:
- Alex Jansen (Cyclone security)
- Samira Patel (Cyclone SSO)
- Neha Kapoor (AE, Redwood)
- Rishi Malhotra (SE, Redwood)
- Marcus Lin (Redwood Security)
- Marissa Cole (SalesOps / procurement follow-up)

We have the following 60–75 minute windows available next week (all PT):
- Tue 2027-12-07: 09:00–10:15 or 11:00–12:15
- Wed 2027-12-08: 09:00–10:15
- Thu 2027-12-09: 08:30–09:45

Agenda (high level):
1) Intro & scope (10m)
2) Redwood security posture and SOC 2 summary (15m)
3) Technical Q&A: network, SSO, data flows (30m)
4) Next steps / procurement checklist (10m)

Can you confirm which slot works for Cyclone and whether procurement should be on the call or handled separately? Also, if there are specific artifacts you want ahead of time (SOC2, network diagram, encryption details), call them out and we’ll send pre-reads.

I’m attaching a short security readiness checklist to speed things up.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: security-readiness-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Alex Jansen <alex.jansen@cyclonelabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cyclonelabs.com
Date: 2027-12-01T13:45:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Cyclone security review - proposed windows and attendees

Neha —

Appreciate the quick summary. High level notes from Cyclone Security: we prefer morning slots PT. Our procurement team needs to be looped for licensing questions, but they do not need to attend the full technical session. Please include them on the follow-up email/notes.

Can Redwood share SOC 2 Type II report (summary) and a high-level network diagram ahead of the call? Also need answers to these quick items before we lock the slot:
- Is there SAML/OIDC provisioning docs for SSO integration?
- Data residency: does Redwood store any customer content by default?
- Access controls: who has access to logs and how long are logs retained?

Proposed slot that works for us: Wed 2027-12-08 at 09:00 PT. If that’s possible, please confirm and send a calendar invite.

I’ve CC’d procurement. If they want to join the final 15 minutes, that’s fine.

Thanks —
Alex Jansen
Director, Information Security | Cyclone Labs
alex.jansen@cyclonelabs.com

On Wed, Dec 1, 2027 at 11:12 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> [original message quoted above]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cyclone security review - proposed windows and attendees

Neha / team —

Confirmed: Wed 2027-12-08 at 09:00 PT should work for Redwood. I’ll draft a single calendar invite and include Procurement with an ask that they join the last 15 minutes. Marcus — can you prepare a one-page SOC 2 summary (redacted) and a high-level network diagram we can share as pre-reads? Also adding Rishi to own the technical demo portion.

Attachments: I’m attaching Cyclone’s initial security questionnaire we received on onboarding so we can pre-fill answers where possible.

I’ll send the invite once Marcus confirms the artifacts.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: cyclone-ss-questions.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Jansen <alex.jansen@cyclonelabs.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-12-04T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cyclone security review - proposed windows and attendees

Alex / team —

Thanks — we can confirm Wed 2027-12-08 09:00 PT for the security review. I’m attaching a 1-page SOC 2 summary and a sanitized network diagram for pre-read. A few notes up front:
- SOC 2 summary: high-level controls and scope; full report available under NDA / MSA if required.
- Network diagram: shows ingress/egress paths and where customer data is transiently cached; no customer content is persisted beyond configured retention periods unless requested.
- SSO: we support SAML and OIDC; I’ll bring details and example metadata during the call.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=abcd1234 (will include in calendar invite).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, network-diagram-redwood.png

Let us know if Cyclone wants an additional 30m pre-call for SSO deep-dive with Samira — we can schedule a separate session.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: network-diagram-redwood.png (PNG)]

From: Alex Jansen <alex.jansen@cyclonelabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@cyclonelabs.com, samira.patel@cyclonelabs.com
Date: 2027-12-05T08:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Cyclone security review - proposed windows and attendees

All —

Thanks, that looks good. Wed 12/08 09:00 PT confirmed on our end. Samira (CC) is our SSO engineer and will join the session. Procurement will be on the call for the final 15 minutes.

A couple quick asks before the meeting:
- Can Redwood share the SOC 2 summary and network diagram as PDFs in the calendar invite pre-read (Marcus attached, thanks)?
- Could you also include any SAML metadata or sample configuration (or a short doc) so Samira can review ahead of time?

We’ve accepted the calendar invite and attached a placeholder invite on our side. Looking forward to the session.

Best —
Alex

[Attachment: calendar-invite-cyclone-sec-review.ics (ICS)]
